# ghost/privacy-friendly-notes

Privacy Friendly Notes (F-Droid): create text notes and checklists, list, search, read and tick items. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/privacy-friendly-notes
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/privacy-friendly-notes open_notes --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/privacy-friendly-notes create_note --device <serial> --param title=<title> --param text=<text>
ghost skill run ghost/privacy-friendly-notes create_checklist --device <serial> --param title=<title> --param items=<items>
ghost skill run ghost/privacy-friendly-notes list_notes --device <serial>

```

## Actions

- `open_notes`: Open my Privacy Friendly Notes list
- `create_note`: Create a text note called Garden plan
- `create_checklist`: Create a checklist called Groceries with milk and eggs
- `list_notes`: List my notes in Privacy Friendly Notes
- `read_note`: Read my note called Garden plan
- `check_item`: Tick milk on my Groceries checklist
- `search_notes`: Search my Privacy Friendly Notes for tomatoes
